options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --input INPUT         Input trajectories directory
  --output OUTPUT       Output directory
  --val-split VAL_SPLIT
                        Validation split fraction
  --exclude-waste-steps
                        Drop retry/backtrack click steps as training targets
                        (kept in history); non-destructive, trajectory files
                        untouched
  --meandering-mode {keep,subsample,exclude}
                        Verifier-graded meandering trajectories: keep all
                        steps, subsample mid-wander targets (head/tail kept,
                        MEANDER_* env knobs), or drop whole
  --exclude-meandering  Deprecated alias for --meandering-mode exclude
  --include-replay      Also train on legacy test-replay trajectories (QA-
                        style supervision; off by default)
  --health-config HEALTH_CONFIG
                        Corpus health thresholds JSON (missing file skips the
                        gate)
  --skip-health-gate    Report health violations but write the dataset anyway
                        (experiments only)
  --grounding-share GROUNDING_SHARE
                        Ceiling on element-grounding click examples as a share
                        of agent step examples (mined from recorded click
                        targets; GROUNDING_* env knobs tune sampling)
  --no-grounding        Alias for --grounding-share 0
  --seed SEED           Seed the split shuffles and the grounding sampler for
                        a reproducible dataset (default: unseeded splits,
                        GROUNDING_SEED for grounding)
